title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Claude Code CLI ships MCP Tasks + Elicitations (public beta, v2.1.304+)
bullets.summary: Announced 23 Oct (previewed at MCPCon NA 22 Oct): MCP servers can run long jobs and report back, and pause mid-task to ask the user for input; CLI, Agent SDK and GitHub Actions only, not VS Code/desktop/Bedrock yet.
bullets.how: The Construct: durable long-running MCP jobs (renders, report builds) fit our scheduled agents; note non-interactive runs cancel elicitations rather than guess. PRAGMA: durable-workflow talking point. Brand 9 Signs: maybe later for long render/order jobs.

bullets.title: Walmart Agent Gateway: an MCP server for approved shopping agents
bullets.summary: Announced 21 Oct: approved AI agents can search inventory and buy on a shopper's behalf; Agent Profiles with per-agent authorization and spending limits follow next month, and agents may not touch payment data directly.
bullets.how: Brand 9 Signs: customer agents will soon buy signage the same way, so keep product feeds and structured data clean and consider an order MCP. PRAGMA: agentic-commerce offer. The Construct: reference design for scoped agent authorization.

bullets.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro (open-weight leader) and DeepSeek V4.1-Flash-1017
bullets.summary: Moonshot's Kimi K3.1 Pro (23 Oct; 2.8T params, 1M context, $2/$10 per 1M) is the top open-weight model on the Artificial Analysis index, weights due Nov 4; DeepSeek V4.1-Flash raised Terminal-Bench 4.0 from 31.2 to 42.3 at unchanged prices with MIT weights.
bullets.how: The Construct: candidate cheap fallback tiers behind a model router; test on non-sensitive batch jobs. PRAGMA: cost-control advice for clients. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: Gemini 4 Argon in Google AI Mode; GPT-6.1 Astra reportedly cancelled after safety tests
bullets.summary: Google's Gemini 4 Argon reached paying users (introductory $2/$10, doubling Dec 1) and expanded into Search AI Mode on 19 Oct, while the WSJ reportedly says OpenAI's October GPT-6.1 Astra was cancelled after internal safety tests (single-aggregator report).
bullets.how: The Construct: price lock-in window ends Dec 1 so benchmark Argon before then. PRAGMA: frontier-model release risk. Brand 9 Signs: AI Mode surfaces affect local signage discovery.

bullets.title: arXiv 2610.11899: Forms of LLM-Integrated Applications, from LLM-Chats to Autonomous Agent Systems
bullets.summary: Weber (submitted 8 Oct, FLLM2026) names seven recurring forms across 22 systems; copilots map to a router-worker design with user confirmation, while agents are AI-planned multi-step execution where the user sees only the outcome.
bullets.how: The Construct: vocabulary to classify our agents as copilot vs agent and decide where confirmation gates belong. PRAGMA: client taxonomy for scoping. Brand 9 Signs: no.

praxis_lesson: Agent autonomy is moving into the protocols (MCP Tasks/Elicitations, Walmart's scoped agent gateway), so design every Construct job as durable and resumable with an explicit human-input path and a scoped, spend-limited credential, rather than assuming a live operator.
